stem: Which sequence best describes an interaction between the integumentary and excretory systems that helps maintain homeostasis?

options.label: F
options.text: Heart rate increases → Blood vessels constrict → Blood pressure increases

options.label: G
options.text: Blood vessel is damaged → Platelets begin to clump → Blood vessel ruptures

options.label: H
options.text: Blood sugar levels rise → Pancreas secretes insulin → Blood sugar continues to rise

options.label: J
options.text: Body temperature increases → Glands release sweat → Body temperature decreases
